posts.title: Negativity broke my blogging
posts.description: How a busy year, a sour drafts folder, and one very disappointing podcast taught me that the choice of subjects can affect your mental health, and that I'd rather write about things I actually like.

posts.title: Testing multiple versions of Python in parallel
